description: Lebanon – Today, Republican John Schlegel announced his intention to seek re-election as staterepresentative. Schlegel is serving his first term representing the 101st district in Lebanon County,which consists of Cornwall Borough, North Cornwall Twp., West Cornwall Twp., Lebanon City,North Lebanon Twp., South Lebanon Twp., and West Lebanon Twp.Schlegel serves on the House Aging and Older Citizens, Children & Youth, Education, and HumanServices Committees.
